span.p:
DB
ek machine nahi jhelti
-> hash(article_id) se tukde, har tukda alag machine, likhai barabar
(shard by article_id)
taazi 20 -> Redis, miss pe har tukde se thoda (scatter-gather)
shard badhaya -> sirf naye hisse ka data hile (consistent hashing)
do shard, wahi khabar -> dedupe saanjhe Bloom / Redis se
